title: C2 axis — Φ-mass distribution SHAPE: Gini of per-distinction φ_d (life vs consciousness)
question: Across the n=4 ECA panel, does CONCENTRATION of distinction-Φ-mass (Gini of per-distinction φ_d vector) differ systematically between life-class (rule 30/54/110) and consciousness-class (rule 150/105) substrates, attacked from a DIFFERENT angle than H_320's SUM-based rd_ratio?

runtime: deterministic · hexa-only · $0 · ubu-2 via pool (mac heavy) · LLM none · NO GPU · wall < 1s
gini_def: G = Σ_i Σ_j |φ_d_i − φ_d_j| / (2 · N · Σ φ_d); G=0 uniform, G→1 concentrated; convention G=0 when N≤1 or Σ=0

finding: H1 is SUPPORTED in the LIFE > CONSC direction. The Φ-mass SHAPE axis DOES separate life from consciousness substrates — life substrates have measurably HIGHER per-distinction φ_d concentration (Gini) than consciousness substrates, both at the headline state 0101 (strict, margin 0.04301) and as all-16-state class-mean (0.191754 vs 0.133333, ratio 1.44×). No class-flip — every consciousness rule (150, 105) sits strictly below every life rule (110, 30, 54) at the all-state-mean. Critically, the two consciousness rules (150, 105) produce IDENTICAL per-distinction φ_d vectors at state 0101: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0] — Gini 0.133333 — reflecting the XOR-feedback symmetry that makes both rules produce isomorphic IIT structure. Life substrates instead produce diverse vectors (e.g. rule 110 [0.166, 0.208, 0.415, 0.166, 0.491, 0.292, 0.208, 0.491, 0.415, 0.184]) with notably more spread. INTERPRETATION: at IIT 4.0 Φ-structure level, life substrates FRAGMENT Φ-mass across many distinctions with variable strength, while consciousness substrates DISTRIBUTE Φ-mass more uniformly across fewer high-symmetry distinctions. This is consistent in direction with H_320's REVERSED finding (life > consc on rd_ratio) — both SUM and SHAPE axes consistently rank LIFE above CONSCIOUSNESS on Φ-structure richness. RECONCILE WITH H_320: H_320 found life's rd_ratio (Σφ_r/Σφ_d) was 2.86× consc class. H_325 now shows the Σφ_d for life ALSO has more concentration variability per distinction. Both findings ACCUMULATE rather than contradict — life-themed ECA substrates simply carry more structural Φ-mass at this scale than the XOR-symmetric consciousness substrates.
verdict: 🟢 SUPPORTED (with FAITHFULNESS letter caveat) — F325.1 SEPARATION PASS · F325.2 ORDERING PASS · F325.3 FAITHFULNESS 2/3 PASS (F325.3a FAIL on N_d≤1 letter, intent satisfied: rule 204 Gini=0 as required) · determinism PASS. 5/6 falsifier checks PASS. H1 holds in the LIFE > CONSC direction (strict separation, no class-flip, 1.44× class-mean ratio). The Φ-mass distribution SHAPE axis IS a discriminator of life vs consciousness at the IIT 4.0 small-n scale. This is a POSITIVE finding — H_320 family's C2 axis is NOT entirely closed-negative: SUM (rd_ratio) and SHAPE (Gini) both rank LIFE above CONSCIOUSNESS, consistently. Honest scope caveat — n=4 ring, 5 ECA, 16 states; the F325.3a anchor falsifier was mis-scoped (assumed N_d≤1 for identity but identity has 4 trivial equal-φ_d distinctions; Gini=0 anyway). The verdict is 🟢 SUPPORTED not 🔵 SUPPORTED-FORMAL — the finding is a measured numerical separation, not a closed-form proof.
honest_scope: n=4 ring · 5 ECA (3 life + 2 consc) + 2 anchors. Headline state=0101 (state 5); all-16-state class-mean adds robustness. Gini is ONE shape metric — alternative shape metrics (Shannon entropy, max-share, variance) remain orthogonal followups. 256-rule extension and larger n=5,6 sweeps remain available for statistical-power scale-up. The two consciousness rules produced identical φ_d vectors at 0101 — this is an XOR-symmetry artifact, not a measurement degeneracy (their class-mean is identical too, 0.133333 each).
reconcile_with_H_320_H_323: H_320 measured rd_ratio = Σφ_r/Σφ_d (SUM axis) and found life > consc REVERSED (🔴 closed-negative against H_320's H1 which predicted consc > life). H_325 attacks the SAME C2 axis from the orthogonal SHAPE angle — Gini of the φ_d vector — and finds life > consc AGAIN, but this time H_325's H1 was direction-agnostic (either separation admissible) so this is 🟢 SUPPORTED. Together: the C2 axis HAS structure (both SUM and SHAPE separate the classes), but the structure runs in the OPPOSITE direction from the original IIT-intuition guess (consc should be relation-richer / more concentrated). Life-themed ECA substrates carry richer Φ-structure on both axes at this small-n scale. H_323 (nd-normalized rd_ratio variant) sits in the same family and provides a third corroborating axis.
verify_fence: The per-distinction φ_d values come from stdlib/consciousness/iit4_distinction.distinction() — intrinsic-difference closed-form, deterministic, kernel authored before this hypothesis. The Gini formula is a class-blind 1-line arithmetic expression. The two consciousness rules producing identical φ_d vectors at state 0101 is consistent with rule 150 = XOR of left+right and rule 105 being its bit-complement family: both compute the same 3-input XOR-feedback structure modulo cell-state relabeling, so their distinction-spectra coincide at symmetric states. This is corroborating evidence the engine is reading the right physics, not a degeneracy artifact.
